• We are under tau+X umbrella at Lepton+X subgroup utilizing the common framework
developed by the group. (𝜏𝜈 + 𝑏 LQ search glance, Tau+X glance)
• Targeting an analysis with only Run-2 data and the quick publication in early 2026.
• 1st EB meeting on Nov. 3rd 2025. (indico)
• 2nd EB meeting on Jan. 9th 2026. (indico)
• Unblind request on Dec. 5th 2025. (indico)
• The unblinding approval was signed off on Jan. 12th.

Physics motivation – B anomaly
• Lepton Flavor Universality (LFU)
➢Weak interaction is universal for 3 lepton flavors in Standard Model.
22/01/2026 Jiaqi ZANG Exotics Approval Meeting 3
• Signs of LFU violation in the B meson decays are reported.
➢ 𝑏 → 𝑐𝑙𝜈 : 𝜏 vs. light leptons (𝜇, 𝑒).
➢ ~ 3.8𝜎 excess over SM (𝐷 and 𝐷∗ combined).
➢ Leptoquark (LQ) is a possible explanation of such violation.
SM
BSM

22/01/2026 Jiaqi ZANG Exotics Approval Meeting 4
Theoretical motivation
• We focus on the vector LQ (U1 scenario) :
• Regardingthe previous LQ searches in CMS and ATLAS:
➢ Pair production: Not depend on the LQ coupling. 𝑚𝐿𝑄 < 1.5 TeV are excluded.
➢ Non-resonant production:
▪ Strongly depends on the LQ coupling, gives a chance to reach unexplored
high-mass region.
▪ CMS and ATLAS has performed the search with 𝜏𝜏 final states, but it’s
sensitive to 𝛽𝐿
33 only.
 Limit of ATLAS LQ searches
(CMS is similar to ATLAS)
➢ 𝑔𝑈: global coupling constant to normalize 𝛽𝐿
33 = 1.0 (b-tau coupling).
➢ 𝛽𝐿
23 (s-tau coupling): coupling that decide the signal strength together with 𝑔𝑈.

22/01/2026 Jiaqi ZANG Exotics Approval Meeting 5
Targetsignals
• We propose a model-independent search with 𝜏𝜈 + 𝑏 final state.
➢ The same diagram as R(D(*)) anomaly.
➢ Also sensitive to the 𝑐𝜈 coupling, which means the signal strength is dominated by not only 𝑔𝑈, but also coupling
𝛽𝐿
23. → To test the large 𝜷𝑳
𝟐𝟑 scenario. (𝛽𝐿

➢ Can cover all possible scenarios to explain R(D*) by a combination with 𝜏𝜏 search.
➢ Not explored by ATLAS/CMS yet. Reinterpretation of 𝑊′ → 𝜏𝜈 is not so sensitive to LQ signals since they don’t
require b-jet.

➢ Large 𝛽𝐿

➢ Both 𝑔𝑈 and 𝛽𝐿

Theory uncertainty estimation
• Theory uncertaintiesfor W+jets and top background are estimated, by following PMG
recommendations.
• Exception: the fraction of b/c jets in W+jets affects our analysis, that is, the fraction of b/c jets could
be the source of the W+jets modeling uncertainties when extrapolating the fit results from b-veto CR
to the b-tag SR/VRs.
• We tested with 10%, 20% and 30% uncertainty on W+jets. The sensitivity is not changed so much
(given it is dominated by data stat uncertainty) and 20% is applied in the end.
• The uncertainty of “transfer factor (CR→SR)” is estimated.
• Most of uncertaintiesare cancelled out between SR/VR and CRand found to be less than 20%.
• CR definition is good, and we can use the phase space very similar to SR/VR.
• Uncertaintiesaffected by poor MC statistics are evaluated with looser selection cuts and /or
smoothing of distribution.
• 𝑍 → 𝜈𝜈 + 𝜏(fake) is a minor source of background.
• The MC modeling for fake tau is not perfect, so we assigned 50% uncertainty on that since we

Physics motivation – B anomaly
• Lepton Flavor Universality (LFU)

• Regardingthe previous LQ searches in CMS and ATLAS:

▪ Strongly depends on the LQ coupling, gives a chance to reach unexplored

• Theory uncertaintiesfor W+jets and top background are estimated, by following PMG
recommendations.

the b-tag SR/VRs.
• We tested with 10%, 20% and 30% uncertainty on W+jets. The sensitivity is not changed so much for
using 20% or 30% (given it is dominated by data stat uncertainty) and 20% is applied in the end.
• The uncertainty of “transferfactor (CR→SR)” is estimated.
• Most of uncertaintiesare cancelled out between SR/VR and CRand found to be less than 20%.
• CR definition is good, and we can use the phase space very similar to SR/VR.
• Uncertaintiesaffected by poor MC statistics are evaluatedwith looser selection cuts and /or
smoothing of distribution.
• 𝑍 → 𝜈𝜈 + 𝜏(fake) is a minor source of background. The MC modeling for fake tau is not perfect, so
we assigned 50% uncertainty on that since we observed disagreement~ 50% between data and
MC in 𝑍 → 𝑙𝑙 + 𝜏(fake) VR.

General info

• We are under tau+X umbrella at Lepton+X subgroup utilizing the common framework
developed by the group. (𝜏𝜈 + 𝑏 LQ search glance, Tau+X glance)
• The analysis is almost finalized:
• The unblinding approval was signed off on Jan. 12th.
• Paper Approval meeting on Mar. 3rd . (indico)
• Currently working on the comments at PAM and 1st paper circulation.

Physics motivation – B anomaly
• Lepton Flavor Universality (LFU)
➢Weak interaction is universal for 3 lepton flavors in Standard Model.
07/04/2026 Jiaqi ZANG AJ Higgs Meeting 4
• Signs of LFU violation in the B meson decays are reported.
➢ 𝑏 → 𝑐𝑙𝜈 : 𝜏 vs. light leptons (𝜇, 𝑒).
➢ ~ 3.8𝜎 excess over SM (𝐷 and 𝐷∗ combined).
➢ Leptoquark (LQ) is a possible explanation of such violation.
SM
BSM

07/04/2026 Jiaqi ZANG AJ Higgs Meeting 5
Theoretical motivation
• We focus on the vector LQ (U1 scenario) :
• Regardingthe previous LQ searches in CMS and ATLAS:
➢ Pair production: Not depend on the LQ coupling. 𝑚𝐿𝑄 < 1.5 TeV are excluded.
➢ Non-resonant production:
▪ Strongly depends on the LQ coupling, gives a chance to reach unexplored
high-mass region.
▪ CMS and ATLAS has performed the search with 𝜏𝜏 final states, but it’s
sensitive to 𝛽𝐿
33 only.
 Limit of ATLAS LQ searches
(CMS is similar to ATLAS)

33 = 1.0 (b-tau coupling).
➢ 𝛽𝐿

Signal diagram in paper
• We propose a first search for LQ signals with𝜏𝜈 final state using the full Run-2 data.
➢ The same diagram as R(D(*)) anomaly.
➢ Focus on the vector LQ (U1 scenario) with parameterized coupling g𝑈 (global coupling) and 𝛽𝐿

➢ Sensitive to the 𝑐𝜈 coupling, which means the signal strength is dominated by not only 𝑔𝑈, but also coupling 𝛽𝐿

➢ Can cover all possible scenarios to explain R(D*) by a combination with 𝜏𝜏 search, which is mainly sensitive to 𝛽𝐿
33.
➢ Not explored by ATLAS/CMS yet. First unique search plane for LQ provided by this analysis!

Theory uncertainty estimation
• Theory uncertaintiesfor W+jets and top background are estimated, by following PMG
recommendations.
• Exception: the fraction of b/c jets in W+jets affects our analysis, that is, the fraction of b/c jets could be
the source of the W+jets modeling uncertainties when extrapolating the fit results from b-veto CR to
the b-tag SR/VRs.
• We tested with 10%, 20% and 30% uncertainty on W+jets. The sensitivity is not changed so much for
using 20% or 30% (given it is dominated by data stat uncertainty) and 30% is applied in the end.
• The uncertainty of “transferfactor (CR→SR)” is estimated.
• Most of uncertaintiesare cancelled out between SR/VR and CRand found to be less than 20%.
• CR definition is good, and we can use the phase space very similar to SR/VR.
• Uncertaintiesaffected by poor MC statistics are evaluatedwith looser selection cuts and /or
smoothing of distribution.
• 𝑍 → 𝜈𝜈 + 𝜏(fake) is a minor source of background. The MC modeling for fake tau is not perfect, so
we assigned 100% uncertainty on that since we observed disagreement~ 50% between data and
MC in 𝑍 → 𝑙𝑙 + 𝜏(fake) VR.
• Diboson and Z+jets are assigned with 30% mis-modeling uncertainty.(The impact on the value is 
very limited, 30% → 50% corresponds to the sensitivity loss less than 1%)

Physics motivation – B anomaly
• Lepton Flavor Universality (LFU)
➢Weak interaction is universal for 3 lepton flavors in Standard Model.
2025/10/21 Jiaqi ZANG ICEPP Analysis meeting 2
• Signs of LFU violation in the B meson decays are reported.
➢ 𝑏 → 𝑐𝑙𝜈 : 𝜏 vs. light leptons (𝜇, 𝑒).
➢ ~ 3.0𝜎 excess over SM (𝐷 and 𝐷∗ combined).
➢ Leptoquark (LQ) is a possible explanation of such violation.

Signal (non-resonance)
• Event topology: exact 1 hadronic tau + exact 1 b-jet (hard/soft pT) + large mET.
• Target signal: 𝜏𝜈 + b jet (hard/soft)

tau nu plus b  LQ search glance Tau+X glance

developed by the group. (𝜏𝜈 + 𝑏 LQ search glance, Tau+X glance)
• Targeting an analysis with only Run-2 data and the quick publication around the end of

indico
• General news
➢EB request talk is given at Lepton+X subgroup meeting on Sep. 8th. (indico)
➢EB members are decided. The first EB meeting is scheduled in the first week of November.
• New signals with inclusive tau w/o HF filter is produced. (validation on-going)
• Theory uncertainties (today’s topic)
• Updated smoothing and validation for theory uncertainties estimation.
• Fit results (today’s topic)
• Updated the pull plots including the theory uncertainties.
• Investigation on the large correlated normalization factors is performed.
• New ntuple production is done.
• Added medium muon SFs to avoid the bug of systematics on loose muon (±100% on
MUON_EFF_RECO_SYS)
• Updated the electron efficiency SFs from R21 to R22. (differ ~2%)
• Updated the b-tag calibration file.

Theory uncertainty estimation
• Theory uncertainties for W+jets and top background are estimated, by following PMG
recommendations.
• Exception: the fraction of b/c jets in W+jets affects our analysis, that is, the fraction of b/c jets could
be the source of the W+jets modeling uncertainties when extrapolating the fit results from b-veto CR
to the b-tag SR/VRs.
→ We decided to apply additional 20% uncertainty for W+jets.
• The uncertainty of “transfer factor (CR→SR)” is estimated.
• Most of uncertainties are cancelled out between SR/VR and CR and found to be less than
20%.
• CR definition is good, and we can use the phase space very similar to SR/VR.
• Unexpected large uncertainties are found: e.g. Top PS. And they are under investigation.
• Could be due to the stat uncertainty.
• SRs selection are relaxed (1𝑏 → ≥ 1𝑏, remove jet multiplicity requirement) only when the alternative
samples have too few events.
• The 353QH smooth algorithm is applied to those uncertainties.

Physics motivation – B anomaly
• Lepton Flavor Universality (LFU)
➢Weak interaction is universal for 3 lepton flavors in Standard Model.
2025/12/23 Jiaqi ZANG ICEPP Analysis meeting 2

➢ ~ 3.8𝜎 excess over SM (𝐷 and 𝐷∗ combined).
➢ Leptoquark (LQ) is a possible explanation of such violation.

Conclusion
• 0tau0b as CR (favoured)
• ~2sigma excess in VR, but seems like statistical fluctuation (we made a careful study)
• ad-hoc 20% uncertainty on W+HF/LF ratio
• post fit W+jets normalization factor 0.89+/-0.08
• 0tau1b as CR (not favored)
• no need to consider W+HF/LF ratio uncertainty
• post fit W+jets normalization factor 1.91+/-0.52 (how to interpret ~2sigma deviation from SM? we know data is 
likely fluctuated)
• 5~10% sensitivity loss
• Difficult to define the VR. 0tau0b and 1tau0b regions are not useful
• both 0tau0b and 0tau1b in the fit, to give a constraint on W+HF/LF ratio uncertainty ( fine to use, but a 
bit aggressive, favoured by the conveners?)
• post fit W+jets normalization factor 0.91+/-0.08
• 1sigma post-fit pull observed for W+HF/LF ratio nuisance parameter. Post fit uncertainty on that nuisance parameter 
is ~0.9 (poor stats in 0tau1b, so not so strong constraint but a bit aggressive comparing to the first method)
• no excess observed in all VRs/CRs
• Sensitivity is comparable to the first method. 
• WVR1tau could be used for the 0b ->1b extrapolation validation?
2025/12/23 Jiaqi ZANG ICEPP Analysis meeting 18

Summary and plans
2025/12/23 Jiaqi ZANG ICEPP Analysis meeting 19
• Signal samples generation for the final interpretation is on-going. But the current results
made with samples applying additional internal weights should be consist with the final
samples.
• Interference contribution is very limited according to the study with 𝑀𝐿𝑄=1.5 T eV samples.
• W+jets HF/LF uncertainty value is fixed to 20% and decorrelated in resonance and non-
resonance regions.
• Possibility of other phase spaces as the WCR is discussed. Need to reach the agreement
with conveners as soon as possible.
Plan
• Address all the comments from experts and convers to get the unblind approval at the start
of next year towards Moriond.
• Final interpretation with new signals samples.
• Apply the fit with toy models since the number of events in SR is less than 10.

BACKUP
2025/12/23 Jiaqi ZANG ICEPP Analysis meeting 20

2025/12/23 Jiaqi ZANG ICEPP Analysis meeting 21
Theoretical motivation
• We focus on the vector LQ (U1 scenario) :
• Regarding the previous LQ searches in CMS and ATLAS:
➢ Pair production: Not depend on the LQ coupling. 𝑚𝐿𝑄 < 1.5 TeV are excluded.
➢ Non-resonant production:
▪ Strongly depends on the LQ coupling, gives a chance to reach unexplored
high-mass region.
▪ CMS and ATLAS has performed the search with 𝜏𝜏 final states, but it’s
sensitive to 𝛽𝐿
33 only.
 Limit of ATLAS LQ searches
(CMS is similar to ATLAS)
➢ 𝑔𝑈: global coupling constant to normalize 𝛽𝐿
33 = 1.0 (b-tau coupling).
➢ 𝛽𝐿
23 (s-tau coupling): coupling that decide the signal strength together with 𝑔𝑈.
➢ Strength of R(D) anomaly is parameterized by 𝑔𝑈
2 (1 +
𝑉𝑐𝑠
𝑉𝑐𝑏
∗ 𝛽𝐿
23). Both 𝑔𝑈 and 𝛽𝐿

𝜏𝜈+b LQ search in LHC-ATLAS motivated by B 
anomaly:
Unblinding Request
Jiaqi Zang1, TakuyaNobe, Stergios Kazakos, TomoyaIizawa, Junichi Tanaka
1The University of Tokyo
Glance, Internal Note
05/12/2025
1
Based on https://arxiv .org/abs/2111.04748
05/12/2025 Jiaqi ZANGUnblinding Request

Physics motivation – B anomaly
• Lepton Flavor Universality (LFU)
➢Weak interaction is universal for 3 lepton flavors in Standard Model.
05/12/2025 Jiaqi ZANG Unblinding Request 2
• Signs of LFU violation in the B meson decays are reported.
➢ 𝑏 → 𝑐𝑙𝜈 : 𝜏 vs. light leptons (𝜇, 𝑒).
➢ ~ 3.8𝜎 excess over SM (𝐷 and 𝐷∗ combined).
➢ Leptoquark (LQ) is a possible explanation of such violation.
SM
BSM

05/12/2025 Jiaqi ZANG Unblinding Request 3
Theoretical motivation
• We focus on the vector LQ (U1 scenario) :
• Regarding the previous LQ searches in CMS and ATLAS:
➢ Pair production: Not depend on the LQ coupling. 𝑚𝐿𝑄 < 1.5 TeV are excluded.
➢ Non-resonant production:
▪ Strongly depends on the LQ coupling, gives a chance to reach unexplored
high-mass region.
▪ CMS and ATLAS has performed the search with 𝜏𝜏 final states, but it’s
sensitive to 𝛽𝐿
33 only.
 Limit of ATLAS LQ searches
(CMS is similar to ATLAS)
➢ 𝑔𝑈: global coupling constant to normalize 𝛽𝐿
33 = 1.0 (b-tau coupling).
➢ 𝛽𝐿
23 (s-tau coupling): coupling that decide the signal strength together with 𝑔𝑈.
➢ Strength of R(D) anomaly is parameterized by 𝑔𝑈
2 (1 +
𝑉𝑐𝑠
𝑉𝑐𝑏
∗ 𝛽𝐿
23). Both 𝑔𝑈 and 𝛽𝐿
23 are important!

05/12/2025 Jiaqi ZANG Unblinding Request 4
Targetsignals
• We propose a model-independent search with 𝜏𝜈 + 𝑏 final state.
➢ The same diagram as R(D(*)) anomaly.
➢ Also sensitive to the 𝑐𝜈 coupling, which means the signal strength is dominated by not only 𝑔𝑈, but also coupling
𝛽𝐿
23. → To test the large 𝜷𝑳
𝟐𝟑 scenario. (𝛽𝐿
33 = 1.0)
➢ Can cover all possible scenarios to explain R(D*) by a combination with 𝜏𝜏 search.
➢ Not explored by ATLAS/CMS yet. Reinterpretation of 𝑊′ → 𝜏𝜈 is not so sensitive to LQ signals since they don’t
require b-jet.
Complementarity 2D search
plane of 𝜏𝜈 and 𝜏𝜏 analysis
• To explain the R(D(*)) anomaly, a sizable 𝑔𝑈
2 (1 +
𝑉𝑐𝑠
𝑉𝑐𝑏
∗ 𝛽𝐿
23) is required.
➢ Small 𝛽𝐿
23 is preferred for the general UV completion for Δ𝐹 = 2 processes. tested by 𝜏𝜏 analysis
➢ Large 𝛽𝐿
23 with small 𝑔𝑈 is remained to test.
➢ Both 𝑔𝑈 and 𝛽𝐿
23 are important to explore the R(D*) anomaly!
Signal diagrams

Analysis overview

• We are under tau+X umbrella utilizing the common framework developed by the group.
(𝜏𝜈 + 𝑏 LQ search glance, Tau+X glance)
• Targeting an analysis with only Run-2 data and the quick publication in early 2026. 1st EB
meeting is given on Nov. 3rd . (indico)
• CP kick-off task: general CP contribution by the tau+X umbrella team. It is considered for
spin-off analysis of the umbrella like us.
• We also strongly contributed to the Run-3 ATLAS operation (~300 OTP/year) and PC
agreed that it can be considered.
• Our latest version of internal note has been reviewed by EB members and liaisons. (CDS)
• All the comments from EB members has been addressed. No major showstoppers.
• Most liaisons signed off the analysis.
• Muon liaison suggested to use HighPt working points instead of Medium working
point. → will discuss later

▪ Included all CP recommeded uncertainties to ntuples.

• Originally we planned to use the MadGraph internal weights to vary 𝑔𝑈 and 𝛽𝐿

• Found the internal weights of our MC samples do not consider the width variation depending on 𝑔𝑈.
• We estimated the additional correction factor as a function of M(𝑏, 𝑡𝑎𝑢) and 𝑝𝑇

distributions generated by the MadGraph directly without the internal weights.
• Contribution of interference between

the high mT cut. The BSM only signals
with additional weights are used in the
following study.

• However,after the discussion with PMG experts, this approach is not favored by them, so
we are generating signals at all parameter points. (JIRA)
• The request was approved with high priority.
• EVNT done; Sim ongoing; Reco possibly can be done by the end of this year .
• But the final signal yields must be consistent with the current sample with the internal
weight applied with additional correction.
• In conclusion, we are still waiting for the final version of the signals, but it must NOT be a
showstopper for the unblinding.

• The uncertainty of “transfer factor (CR→SR)” is estimated.
